items.title: 31.2 Material science mein zehreelapan aur recycling (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of toxicity and recycling (PDF 221).

blocks.text: Jadeed zindagi mumkin banane wale materials nuqsan bhi de sakte hain. Yeh hissa dekhta hai ke materials apni tayyari, istemal aur thikane lagane (disposal) ke dauran kaise zehreele ho sakte hain (31.2.1), zehreele materials ke do bare groups, heavy metals aur plastics (31.2.2), aur recycling, jo wasail aur tawanai bachati hai lekin takneeki aur maashi mushkilat rakhti hai (31.2.3).

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein zer-e-bahas zehreele materials ke do bare groups batayein.
blocks.explanation: Heavy metals (lead, mercury, cadmium) aur plastics.

items: Zehreelapan, bare zehreele materials aur recycling 31.2.1 se 31.2.3 mein.
